items.title: John Beal interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2024
items.q: I’ll quote Mose Allison, he said, “Play every chance you get — play every chance you get.”

ctx.x: If you had — I’m going to ask you think back — in 1974 I’m going back from 2024 — what kind of advice might you have given to someone coming up as opposed to the advice you would give them now? Can we talk about what you would have said to a 19- year-old musician in 1974 trying to find a place in the business?

I guess just play — I’ll quote Mose Allison, he said, “Play every chance you get — play every chance you get.” Now there’s not as many opportunities. There’s plenty of musicians around but the opportunities are limited. All those gigs, you know, don’t pay very much. It’s hard to make a living at this time.
It’s frustrating to think why has this occurred. I guess there’s a number of reasons why some of those gigs have gone away: DJs etcetera.
